# ADRs

Use the headings in `docs/adr/template.md`. That file follows MADR v4.0.0
(CC0-1.0), which hve-core embeds in
`.github/instructions/project-planning/adr-standards.instructions.md`.

Status is one of: proposed, accepted, rejected, deprecated, superseded.

Do not mark an ADR accepted unless the decision is already recorded in the
rebuild plan or a person has accepted it in the PR. Agents may open an ADR
as `proposed`.
